description: This file contains unit tests for the WorkActivityStore class, verifying its behavior in handling jobs and tools, icon state updates, and label extraction within a macOS application.

classes.name: WorkActivityStoreTests
classes.description: A test suite for the WorkActivityStore class, including tests for job preemption, tool handling, label extraction, and icon state resolution.

methods.name: `main session job preempts other`
methods.description: Tests that a new job with session key 'main' preempts other jobs and updates the icon state accordingly.

methods.name: `job stays working after tool result grace`
methods.description: Verifies that the job's working state persists after a tool's result phase, using asynchronous waiting.

methods.name: `tool label extracts first line and shortens home`
methods.description: Checks that the label extraction from tool commands shortens the home directory and extracts the first line.

methods.name: `resolve icon state honors override selection`
methods.description: Ensures that the icon state resolution respects manual override settings.
